title: Build the first agent-collaborative game
summary: Create a game where builders can use their own agents to create static or agent-directed dynamic levels, and players can be humans or agents.
acceptance_criteria: The game contract supports static levels.
The game contract supports agent-directed dynamic levels.
The player contract supports human players.
The player contract supports agent players.
Builders can submit levels through GitHub as reviewable manifests.
Reference static and dynamic levels pass validation.
constraints: Dynamic director agents must stay inside declared permissions.
Human and agent players must use the same declared level rules.
The first slice should define contracts before implementing a full engine.
success_metrics: A builder can add a level manifest without changing core protocol files.
A player agent can infer valid observations and actions from a level manifest.
A reviewer can tell whether a dynamic level is fair by reading its director contract.
